name: Jeremy Thamert
bio: Jeremy Gale Thamert is Owner and President of MH Construction, Inc., where he leads relationship-first project delivery for commercial and industrial construction across the Inland Northwest. Independent reporting describes his 14 years as a U.S. Army flight engineer, and public records document his background in construction ownership, renewable-energy entrepreneurship, and Oregon inspector and plans-examiner credential identifiers. He aligns field execution, client communication, and long-term strategy so every project is delivered with accountability, precision, and trust.
careerHighlights: Leads company-wide mission alignment from client kickoff through final closeout.
Independent reporting describes 14 years of U.S. Army flight-engineer service that shaped his discipline and accountability standards.
Built and scaled multiple businesses with disciplined operational systems, including renewable-energy entrepreneurship.
Maintains leadership visibility through verified public records, independent stories, and community participation.
Guides strategic growth while protecting MH relationship-first standards across Washington, Oregon, and Idaho.
Mentors leaders to strengthen accountability, communication, and execution.
funFact: Jeremy is most energized when aligning people, safety, and execution around one clear mission.
certifications: Oregon public records list inspector and plans-examiner credential identifiers (including OIC3191, Structural Inspector A-Level, Mechanical Inspector A-Level, Structural Plans Examiner A-Level, and Fire and Life Safety Plans Examiner references).
